description: Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/washer_notes_raw.xlsx containing scattered notes about washing machine problems. Create a diagnostic analysis spreadsheet with three sheets: (1) 'Incident Log' - structured data table with at least 12 incidents, columns for Date, Days Since Last Incident (calculated), Problem Category, Severity, Cycle Phase, Load Type, and Notes (exclude 'ran fine' entries); (2) 'Pattern Analysis' - frequency tables, statistics (average days between incidents), and pattern observations; (3) 'Technician Summary' - one-page report with problem overview, most frequent issues, and critical observations. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
